name: Deployment

subjectOf.text: Experimental studies suggest risks such as bias amplification from judicial AI, but there is little empirical data on how those risks actually manifest in operational courtrooms, which leaves practical integration guidelines undeveloped.
subjectOf.abstract: While experimental studies suggest risks like bias amplification, there is little empirical data on how these risks manifest in operational judicial settings.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Morgan A. Gray, The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5541658
scope_conditions: the gap between experimental and deployed judicial AI systems
